visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Shift and Mask Instead of Building a Number
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The binary digits are assembled into a decimal-looking number with a place counter. Use shifts and masks to print the bits directly. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: (n >> i) & 1 reads bit i directly. The old version stored the binary digits inside an int, which overflows for larger numbers: a 32-bit value needs 32 decimal digits. Printing the bits has no such limit.
